configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: cd server && CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 npm start

configurations._comment: Throwaway API against a scratch database, for verifying UI work without touching server/data. Seed it first: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch ADMIN_USERNAME=dev ADMIN_PASSWORD=scratch-dev-password npm run seed
configurations.name: api-scratch
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 npm start

configurations._comment: api-scratch with a stub mailer that prints each email instead of sending it (server/scripts/dev-stub-mail.js), for the send panel and queue. STUB_MAIL_FAIL=1 makes every send fail.
configurations.name: api-scratch-mail
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ node scripts/dev-stub-mail.js

configurations._comment: A never-configured database, for verifying the first-run setup steps on the estimates empty state — those only render while the pricing and settings rows have never been written, which api-scratch's database has. Delete /tmp/lsc-billing-firstrun to reset it. Seed it first: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-firstrun ADMIN_USERNAME=dev ADMIN_PASSWORD=<12+ chars> npm run seed
configurations.name: api-firstrun
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-firstrun CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 npm start
